source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    peaks = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value != 0]
    for r in range(height):

            left, right = peak - r, peak + r
            for c in range(max(0, left + (r > 0)), min(width, right)):
